name: Odani Castle
description: Odani Castle was the mountain stronghold of the Azai clan, destroyed after the 1573 fall of Azai Nagamasa — the setting of the famous 'Odani no hara' tragedy. Its deep kuruwa and moats survive on a steep ridge.
notes: Free open-air site with a demanding climb; the Odani Castle History Museum at the base (fee) provides context.

ja.name: 小谷城
ja.description: 浅井長政の居城だった小谷城。1573年の滅亡は「小谷のほら貝」の悲話で知られ、急峻な尾根に遺構が残ります。
ja.notes: 無料の野外遺構で登城はハード。麓の小谷城戦国歴史資料館（有料）が案内役です。
